description: Replace paginated calorie balance chart with a continuous-scroll list grouped into 7-day windows. Each window shows a summary header with avg daily balance, total balance, and trend indicator, followed by the daily bar rows. Visually separated with background and dividers.

userStories.title: Partition DailyBalance list into 7-day BalanceWindow chunks
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to group DailyBalance entries into 7-day windows with computed metrics so the UI can render per-week summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `BalanceWindow` data class with fields: balances: List<DailyBalance>, avgDailyBalance: Double, totalBalance: Double, trend: TrendDirection
Create `TrendDirection` enum: IMPROVING, STABLE, DECLINING
Create `List<DailyBalance>.groupByWeeks()` extension that chunks into groups of 7 (oldest first)
Partial windows (< 7 days) are handled without crash
Trend = compare mean of first 3 vs last 3 days; diff > 50 → IMPROVING, < -50 → DECLINING, else STABLE
Partial windows with < 6 entries default to STABLE
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Refactor CalorieBalanceChart to use LazyColumn with BalanceWindow sections
userStories.description: As a user, I want to scroll continuously through my calorie balance history grouped by week, with each week showing a summary header and daily bar rows.
acceptanceCriteria: CalorieBalanceChart accepts List<DailyBalance> and groups internally using groupByWeeks()
LazyColumn renders one WindowSection per BalanceWindow
Each WindowSection = summary header + daily CalorieBalanceRow items
Scroll is continuous — no pagination or snapping between windows
onBarClick callback still fires on daily row tap
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Display 7-day window summary header with metrics
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see weekly metrics above each 7-day group so I can quickly understand how that week performed.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary header appears above each 7-day window's daily rows
Header shows: avg daily balance (e.g. 'Avg: +150/day'), total balance (e.g. 'Total: +1050'), trend icon (↗/→/↘)
Trend icon color: green for IMPROVING, red for DECLINING, neutral for STABLE
Header uses distinct background from daily rows (surfaceVariant at reduced alpha)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Visual grouping with separator and subtle window background
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear visual separation between weeks so I can distinguish windows at a glance while scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Each 7-day window section has a subtle background (surfaceVariant ~5-30% alpha)
1dp HorizontalDivider separates each window
Daily rows within a window share the window background
Divider is visible but not visually heavy
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Show calorie balance value on each daily row
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the calorie balance number on each bar row so I don't have to mentally estimate from bar length.
acceptanceCriteria: Each daily row displays formatted balance value (e.g. '+350', '-1.2k') at end of row
Balance value color matches bar color (green for positive, red for negative)
Value is readable at default font size
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Flatten chart to single scrollable list of all days (no fixed chunks)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the fixed 7-day chunk grouping so all days render as a flat LazyColumn, enabling the rolling window header to track any 7-day slice.
acceptanceCriteria: CalorieBalanceChart renders all DailyBalance entries as a flat LazyColumn (one row per day, no BalanceWindow section grouping)
Remove BalanceWindow section headers and background grouping from the list items
LazyListState is created and passed to the LazyColumn for scroll position tracking
LazyListState is exposed from CalorieBalanceChart (returned or hoisted) so parent can read firstVisibleItemIndex
onBarClick callback still fires on each daily row tap
HorizontalDivider between rows kept for visual separation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add sticky rolling 7-day window summary header that tracks visible rows
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a summary header above the list that always shows metrics for the 7 days currently visible, updating as I scroll so I always know my rolling weekly average.
acceptanceCriteria: A summary card is pinned above the LazyColumn (not inside it) showing: date range label (e.g. 'May 1 – May 7'), avg daily balance, total balance, trend icon (↗/→/↘)
Summary derives its 7-day window from LazyListState.firstVisibleItemIndex: window = balances[firstVisibleItemIndex .. firstVisibleItemIndex + 6] (clamped to list bounds)
Summary updates on every scroll using derivedStateOf { listState.firstVisibleItemIndex } to avoid excess recomposition
Trend uses existing TrendDirection logic (first 3 vs last 3 days of the visible 7)
When fewer than 7 days remain at bottom of list, window shows last 7 days (or all days if list < 7)
Summary card uses Card or Surface with elevation to visually float above the list
Typecheck passes
